people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
translations.bsb: “Your glory, O Israel, lies slain on your heights. How the mighty have fallen!
translations.kjv: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
translations.asv: Thy glory, O Israel, is slain upon thy high places! How are the mighty fallen!
